title: 巴拿马运河限行再收紧：从36到32，实际通行量已降至24艘？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Before we get to the nitty-gritty, you were just sworn in. I think less than 48 hours ago, but, I mean, you go back.
segments.zh: 在我们深入细节之前，你刚宣誓就职，不到48小时前，但你其实早就开始了。

segments.en: I mean, you've been there a long time. I mean, 40 years ago, riding that train up in Cologne as a temporary hire, the only woman engineer out there
segments.zh: 你在这里很久了。40年前，作为临时工在科隆的火车上，是船厂里唯一的女工程师。

segments.en: in the canal shipyard, and now you're running the whole thing. It's got to feel good, Ilia, doesn't it?
segments.zh: 现在你管理整个运河。伊利亚，感觉一定很好吧？

segments.en: Yes, it does feel good. I'm excited, super excited with this new challenge.
segments.zh: 是的，感觉很好。我很兴奋，对这个新挑战超级兴奋。

segments.en: Well, let's talk about some of those challenges. I mean, on the plus side, I mean, the canal is taking in record revenue.
segments.zh: 让我们谈谈这些挑战。从好的方面看，运河收入创纪录。

segments.en: But we start to talk about some of the issues facing you with regards to actually being able to get ships through the canal, of course, with the severe El Nino
segments.zh: 但我们也面临一些实际问题，比如让船只通过运河，当然还有严重的厄尔尼诺现象。

segments.en: forecast coming through. Give me a sense of what your modeling is right now for the next few months as to what transits are actually going to look like
segments.zh: 告诉我你未来几个月的模型预测，实际过境情况会怎样？

segments.en: relative to what they were a year ago.
OK, we definitely are being hit by El Nino.
segments.zh: 是的，我们确实受到了厄尔尼诺的影响。

segments.en: So we already announced draft restrictions and also reduce two slots from 36 days to 34, and eventually we'll go to 32.
segments.zh: 我们已经宣布了吃水限制，并将每日通行名额从36个减少到34个，最终会减到32个。

segments.en: The good news is that the last few days we've had a little bit of rainfall that has allowed us to postpone the further draft restriction.
segments.zh: 好消息是，最近几天下了些雨，让我们得以推迟进一步的吃水限制。

segments.en: So we maintain that 34 transits. We maintain the 48 foot draft.
segments.zh: 因此我们维持34次通行，以及48英尺的吃水深度。
